bpmn:process.name: Video game training
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: A between-subjects training study. After the instructions, a personality questionnaire and two baseline tests, each participant is allocated at random to play an action video game (AVGP), play Tetris (Control), or rest (NVGP), then takes the 2-back again.

cognitive:instruction.content: Thank you for taking part. You will take two short tests, then play a game or rest, then take one test again.

bpmn:task.name: Useful Field of View (central detection task)

cognitive:instruction.content: Thank you. The study compares an action video game with Tetris and with rest, by the 2-back score before and after.
